pages.markdown:
Founded in 2001, Hikvision has grown from a 28-person start-up to a global tech company. Over the past 
two decades, Hikvision has been serving various industries with cutting-edge technologies such as machine 
perception, artiﬁcial intelligence and big data. 
Starting with visible light, Hikvision’s perception technology has evolved into a comprehensive array of 
capabilities spanning the entire spectrum and integrating diverse AI technologies. While the security sector 
remains crucial, it represents just one aspect of our AIoT capabilities. Through continuous development, 
Hikvision has become the leading provider of AIoT products and solutions.In 2023, Hikvision's AIoT strategy continued to drive innovation and development, resulting in record high 
revenues of 12.68 billion USD. With over 58,000 professionals and 80 subsidiaries/branch oﬃces around the 
world, we provide outstanding products, solutions, and services.
Moving forward, Hikvision remains committed to enhancing safety and sustainable development through 
the power of technology. We will explore more innovative ways to perceive and understand the world, 
empowering the vision for a safer and better future.Leading the Future of AIoT

Extensive R&D  Capabilities
Hikvision runs extensive manufacturing operations in China and other countries, with an annual capacity of 
more than 580,000 units per day. Our intelligent manufacturing capabilities include agile information systems, 
automated production lines, ﬂexible warehouse systems, and intelligent scheduling systems. 
In addition, we prioritize product quality across the manufacturing lifecycle, covering processes such as 
material selection, quality testing, and after-sales service.Intelligent Manufacturing with Robust Quality

revenue in 2023. Additionally, it has established 11 R&D centers 
worldwide, including in the UK, the UAE, and Mexico.

bringing us closer to our customers and partners. This wide reach enables us to promptly address customer 
needs and collaborate with partners for mutual success.
To provide high-quality services and dedicated local support, we have set up 18 regional logistics centers and 
over 400 after-sales service points worldwide. Global Marketing & Service Network

security and streamline operations, driving digital transformation. For SMBs, we provide one-stop solutions

Founded in 2001, Hikvision has grown from a 28-person start-up to a global tech company. Over the past 
two decades, Hikvision has been serving various industries with cutting-edge technologies such as machine 
perception, artiﬁcial intelligence and big data. 
Starting with visible light, Hikvision’s perception technology has evolved into a comprehensive array of 
capabilities spanning the entire spectrum and integrating diverse AI technologies. While the security sector 
remains crucial, it represents just one aspect of our AIoT capabilities. Through continuous development, 
Hikvision has become the leading provider of AIoT products and solutions.In 2023, Hikvision's AIoT strategy continued to drive innovation and development, resulting in record high 
revenues of 12.68 billion USD. With over 58,000 professionals and 80 subsidiaries/branch oﬃces around the 
world, we provide outstanding products, solutions, and services.
Moving forward, Hikvision remains committed to enhancing safety and sustainable development through 
the power of technology. We will explore more innovative ways to perceive and understand the world, 
empowering the vision for a safer and better future.Leading the Future of AIoT
